what: Public dev-origin HTTP mutations and WebSockets are rejected.
expected: Browser requests from the public dev origin succeed; foreign origins remain denied.
observed: Same-origin function invocation returned 403 ORIGIN_DENIED and WebSocket closed 1011.
root_cause: proxy-forward.ts removed Host and proxy-websocket.ts did not retain public Host. Bun reconstructed request.url using the private child authority, so transport-security.ts compared the public Origin with the wrong port.
fixed_by: Preserve the public request URL authority in Host for HTTP and WebSocket forwarding. Same real API reproduction and regression tests now pass.

invariants: Browser requests from the public dev origin succeed; foreign origins remain denied.
Foreign origins remain rejected; successful tools and event streams retain their contracts.
